source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Weapons & Where to Find Them
source_excerpt:
Phantom Blade Zero features a wide variety of weapons and Phantom Edges to try, with many unlocked by defeating the main story bosses. Rather than sticking with the same weapons throughout the game, experiment with new ones as you acquire them. You can upgrade weapons to level 10 without worrying about losing resources when switching, and even after level 10, you can recover your resources by using a Talisman.
The table below includes weapon images and locations. Some weapons may look different or have different names if they have been Soul Tempered.
Found in a weapon rack right after meeting Yu'er, when she gives you the Flesh Lily quest .
Found next to the Blacksmith at the Outpost.
